scoring_justification: BCS integral solution with DOS computation is heavy; verifier compares agent's reported Tc and alpha against paper-reported gold values and structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Tc and alpha values for key conditions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2, Fig.3 and text (Tc~60 K, alpha=0.327 for gamma=0 delta=0; Tc~6 K, alpha=0.5 for gamma=1 delta=0; approximate values for intermediate gammas).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported approximate numbers and trends.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values.

outputs.description: The agent's computed BCS transition temperature Tc and isotope effect exponent alpha for various anisotropy ratios gamma and Fermi-level deviations delta. The hidden checker compares these values to the paper-reported reference values and verifies structural trends (peak location, monotonicity).

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the tight-binding DOS calculation and the numerical solution of the BCS integral equation independently. The output must contain the required (gamma, delta) grid. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed.

steps.description: Check that all required (gamma,delta) conditions are present.
Compare Tc and alpha at key (gamma,delta) points against paper-reported values.
Verify Tc peak at delta=0 for gamma=0, monotonic decrease; alpha minimum at delta=0 for gamma=0; constant values for gamma=1.
